name: Rilkan
printedArtCredit: Mark Poole, male and female Rilkan illustration, p. 13, and Tarrenta Willet portrait, p. 14.
sourceDistinctions: Racial Knowledge uses shaped soulmeld count, independent of invested essentia. Rilkans do not receive an innate pool.
Racial Aid adds +3 to another Rilkan’s roll. Improved Flanking increases the attack bonus only for Rilkans who are actually flanking the same target.
The first-level Rogue substitution causes the permanent one-die sneak attack reduction. The optional 3rd-level substitution does not impose that reduction on its own.
The published Rilkan Incarnate lists a +1 racial Knowledge bonus despite four shaped soulmelds. The racial formula instead gives +3. The staged NPCs use the racial formula.
portraitForm: Kesra Tarn, an original Rilkan Rogue
